summary.text: Jenni Furtado is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 64 since January 7, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was formerly known as Jenni Azanero and previously served on the East Providence School Committee.

paragraphs.text: Furtado earned a bachelor's degree from St. John's University in 2015 and a law degree from Roger Williams University Law School in 2019.
She served on the East Providence School Committee before her election to the House.
